title: WhatsApp image request: an ordinary product with no photo on file replies with accurate text, not a broken image
notes: Same request path as conv_328 ('show me the Jawbreaker'), proving item 3's requirement that the same image-request capability works for ordinary products too -- 'The Nightcap' has no image_url on file, so this must degrade to an accurate text reply (name, price, description) rather than attempting to send a missing/broken image or falling through to the unrelated full-menu dump.
